title: Solar Storm on August 1, 2010
description: The coronal mass ejection starts at 2:36 UTC and ends at 3:56 UTC on August 1 in this animation  on STEREO Ahead images. The coronal mass ejection happens quickly. It is the eruption of particles bursting from the left side of the Sun, just below the centre. The animation shows the cloud of particles moving away toward Earth at more than 1,000 kilometres per second (3.6 million kilometres per hour), moving more quickly than any other coronal mass ejection in years.
